article.title: Why Deep Work Matters
article.content: In an age of constant notifications, focused attention has become rare. Many students believe that multitasking helps them finish more work, but research shows the opposite. When people switch between tasks, they waste time and mental energy. Deep work means doing one demanding task with full concentration for a fixed period. It may feel uncomfortable at first, yet the benefits are clear. You remember ideas better, solve problems faster, and produce higher quality results. To build this habit, start with short sessions. Turn off alerts, keep your phone away, and set a clear goal before each session. Over time, your brain adapts, and concentration becomes easier.
article.translation: 在通知不断的时代，专注注意力变得稀缺。许多学生认为多任务能让他们完成更多工作，但研究显示恰恰相反。人在任务间切换时会浪费时间和心理能量。深度工作指在固定时段内全神贯注地完成一项高要求任务。起初可能不舒服，但收益很明显：你会更容易记住观点、更快解决问题，并产出更高质量结果。要培养这个习惯，可以从短时段开始：关闭提醒、把手机放远、每次开始前设定明确目标。随着时间推移，大脑会逐渐适应，专注也会变得更轻松。
